core_obligations: A complex-potential resolvent approximation does not establish a uniform boundary observability time. The source balances high-frequency semigroup decay with the two boundary Agmon actions, proves frequency-uniform observability above the upper threshold and constructs nonobservable concentrating modes below the lower threshold, yielding the exact native symmetric value when the actions coincide.
